cleaned_text: HDFC Flexi Cap Fund - Official Scheme Page HDFC Flexi Cap Fund AMC: HDFC Asset Management Company Limited Category: Flexi Cap Fund - An open-ended dynamic equity scheme investing across large cap, mid cap, and small cap stocks. Fund Type: Open-Ended Equity Scheme Launch Date: January 01, 1995 (one of the oldest equity funds in India) Plan Options: Direct Plan and Regular Plan, available in Growth and IDCW (Income Distribution cum Capital Withdrawal) options. Net Asset Value (NAV) & Assets Under Management (AUM) Net Asset Value (NAV): As of June 01, 2026, the Net Asset Value (NAV) for HDFC Flexi Cap Fund is Rs. 1,850.30 for the Direct Plan and Rs. 1,620.75 for the Regular Plan. Assets Under Management (AUM): As of April 30, 2026, the Assets Under Management (AUM) for HDFC Flexi Cap Fund is Rs. 55,230 Crores. NAV History: The NAV of the Direct Plan was Rs. 1,520.40 on June 01, 2025, Rs. 1,050.22 on June 01, 2023, and Rs. 620.80 on June 01, 2019. Fund Manager The fund is managed by Mr. Roshi Jain , who joined HDFC Asset Management in 2022. Mr. Jain has over 18 years of experience in equity research and fund management. He previously worked at Franklin Templeton Investments as a portfolio manager. He holds a CFA charter and an MBA from XLRI Jamshedpur. His investment approach combines bottom-up stock picking with a strong focus on valuation discipline and quality of earnings. Co-fund manager: Mr. Dhruv Muchhal assists in managing the portfolio, focusing on sector-specific research in technology and consumer sectors. Scheme Suitability & Riskometer This product is suitable for investors who are seeking long-term capital appreciation by investing in equity and equity-related instruments across market capitalizations. The riskometer for HDFC Flexi Cap Fund is classified as Very High . Being a flexi-cap fund, it provides the fund manager flexibility to shift allocations between large-cap, mid-cap, and small-cap stocks based on market conditions and valuations. Recommended investment horizon: 5+ years. Benchmark The benchmark index for HDFC Flexi Cap Fund is the Nifty 500 TRI (Total Returns Index). The additional benchmark is the BSE Sensex TRI. Historical Returns & Performance The following are the historical returns for HDFC Flexi Cap Fund (Direct Plan) as of May 31, 2026: 1-Year Return: 19.75% (Benchmark: 17.50%) 3-Year Return (CAGR): 21.80% (Benchmark: 19.30%) 5-Year Return (CAGR): 20.45% (Benchmark: 18.20%) 10-Year Return (CAGR): 16.90% (Benchmark: 15.10%) Since Inception Return (CAGR): 18.25% (Benchmark: 14.80%) Note: Past performance may or may not be sustained in the future. Returns are calculated on a CAGR basis for periods greater than one year. Portfolio Composition & Sector Allocation As of April 30, 2026, the portfolio of HDFC Flexi Cap Fund holds approximately 55 stocks. The market cap allocation is: Large Cap 62%, Mid Cap 25%, Small Cap 13%. The key sector allocation is as follows: Financial Services & Banking: 28.5% Information Technology: 15.2% Oil, Gas & Energy: 10.8% Healthcare & Pharmaceuticals: 9.5% Automobile & Auto Ancillaries: 8.2% Consumer Goods (FMCG): 7.6% Metals & Mining: 5.8% Others: 14.4% Top 5 holdings include: ICICI Bank Ltd (8.5%), HDFC Bank Ltd (7.2%), Infosys Ltd (5.8%), Bharti Airtel Ltd (4.5%), and Axis Bank Ltd (4.0%). Investment Details & Minimum Amounts Minimum SIP Amount: Rs. 100 per month and in multiples of Re. 1 thereafter. Minimum Initial Investment (Lumpsum): Rs. 100 and in multiples of Re. 1 thereafter. Minimum Additional Purchase: Rs. 100 and in multiples of Re. 1 thereafter. SIP Frequency Options: Monthly, Quarterly, and Weekly SIP options are available. SIP Date Options: Investors can choose any date from the 1st to 28th of the month for SIP deductions. Systematic Transfer Plan (STP): Available for transfers between HDFC mutual fund schemes. Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP): Minimum withdrawal of Rs. 500 per installment. Expense Ratio As of April 30, 2026, the Expense Ratio for HDFC Flexi Cap Fund is as follows: Direct Plan: 0.78% per annum Regular Plan: 1.62% per annum The expense ratio is charged on a daily accrual basis and is reflected in the fund's NAV. It includes management fees, custodian charges, audit fees, and other operational costs. Exit Load Details The exit load structure for HDFC Flexi Cap Fund is defined as follows: For redemption/switch-out within 1 year (365 days) from the date of allotment: 1.00% of the applicable NAV. For redemption/switch-out after 1 year (365 days) from the date of allotment: Nil . No exit load is applicable for units allotted through dividend reinvestment or Systematic Transfer Plan (STP) units. Tax Implications The tax treatment for HDFC Flexi Cap Fund investments is as per the prevailing Income Tax Act, 1961: Short-Term Capital Gains (STCG): Units sold within 12 months are taxed at 20% (plus applicable surcharge and cess). Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG): Units sold after 12 months — gains exceeding Rs. 1.25 lakh per financial year are taxed at 12.5% (plus applicable surcharge and cess). Dividend (IDCW) Distribution: Dividends are taxable in the hands of investors at their applicable slab rate. TDS of 10% is deducted for dividends exceeding Rs. 5,000 in a financial year for resident investors. SIP Calculator & Wealth Creation A monthly SIP of Rs. 10,000 in the Direct Plan of HDFC Flexi Cap Fund, started 10 years ago, would have grown to approximately Rs. 28.5 Lakhs (total investment of Rs. 12 Lakhs), representing an annualized return (XIRR) of approximately 17.8%. A monthly SIP of Rs. 5,000 started 5 years ago would have grown to approximately Rs. 4.8 Lakhs (total investment of Rs. 3 Lakhs). Risk Factors Investments in HDFC Flexi Cap Fund are subject to the following risk factors: Market Risk: The fund's NAV is subject to fluctuations based on stock market movements, economic conditions, and global factors. Allocation Risk: As a flexi-cap fund, the portfolio's market-cap allocation may shift significantly, leading to varying risk profiles over time. Concentration Risk: Large holdings in banking and financial services sector may lead to sector-specific risks. Currency Risk: Any international holdings may be affected by currency fluctuations. Regulatory Risk: Changes in SEBI regulations, RBI policies, or government tax laws may impact fund performance. How to Invest Investors can invest in HDFC Flexi Cap Fund through the following channels: HDFC Mutual Fund official website (www.hdfcfund.com), HDFC Mutual Fund mobile app, authorized distributors and financial advisors, online investment platforms such as Groww, Zerodha Coin, Kuvera, and Paytm Money, and AMFI-registered Mutual Fund Distributors (MFDs). Last updated from sources: June 01, 2026.
